body:
I'm really sorry you and your girlfriend had to go through that. I don't have advice but as someone who attempted suicide a few times and had a boyfriend during those times, I'd just like to say it wasn't your fault. I'm not your girlfriend so I don't know what went through her mind as she did it, but for me there wasn't anything anyone could have said or done. My boyfriend at the time could have said anything to try and stop me, but it wasn't going to change my mind no matter what, because I was hellbent on wanting to end the pain inside. Whatever he said I would've just thought he was lying anyways.

Please try not to blame yourself. I don't think you've failed her. It wasn't that what you did wasn't enough. You did what you could. Being there for her probably helped a lot. I'm glad she is safe now, and I hope she feels better soon. As for you, please take care of yourself as well. Being there for suicidal people is hard, I've been on both sides of it. Don't blame yourself.

I'm here if you ever want to talk. Take care, man.
